note.first: सहायक सरकारी वकील, मा. उच्च न्यायालय, खंडपीठ औरंगाबाद यांच्या पृ.1/प.वि. वरील दि. __.__.2026 रोजीच्या पत्रास अनुसरून सादर.
paras: उपरोक्त याचिकेच्या अनुषंगाने सदर प्रकरणाची पार्श्वभूमी थोडक्यात खालीलप्रमाणे आहे:-

विधीविषयक कामकाज चालविण्याचे नियम, 1984 (Rules for the Conduct of the Legal Affairs of Government, 1984) मधील नियम 58(3) मध्ये “shall prepare or obtain parawise report on all the points raised in the Writ Petition and affidavit.” अशी तरतूद आहे. नियम 58(4) मध्ये प्रकरणाची कागदपत्रे “within two weeks from the date of receipt by it” सरकारी वकील यांना पाठविण्याची तरतूद आहे.
याचिकेतील प्रत्येक परिच्छेदावरील या विभागाचे अभिप्राय या विभागाच्या अभिलेखाच्या आधारे इंग्रजीमध्ये तयार करण्यात आले आहेत. सदर अभिप्रायांसोबत संबंधित शासन निर्णयांच्या प्रती जोडण्यात आल्या आहेत.

0: (1) सदर पत्रान्वये रिट याचिका क्र. ____/2026 (श्री. अ. ब. चाचणी विरुद्ध महाराष्ट्र शासन व इतर) मध्ये प्रतिवादी क्र. 2 (विधि व न्याय विभाग) यांचे परिच्छेदनिहाय अभिप्राय पाठविण्याबाबत कळविण्यात आले आहे. सदर याचिका दि. __.__.2026 रोजी सुनावणीसाठी आहे (पृ.1/प.वि.).
(3) सदर निवेदन मा. उच्च न्यायालयाच्या दि. __.__.2025 रोजीच्या पत्रासोबत शासनास प्राप्त झाले होते (पृ.3/प.वि.).
(4) या विभागाने क्र. संकिर्ण-2025/____/प्र.क्र.____/का.6, दि. __.__.2025 च्या पत्रान्वये सदर निवेदनाबाबत मा. उच्च न्यायालयास कळविले होते (पृ.4/प.वि.).
(5) याचिकाकर्त्याने रिट याचिका क्र. ____/2026 दाखल केली असून या विभागास प्रतिवादी क्र. 2 करण्यात आले आहे (पृ.5-12/प.वि.).

note.closing: सबब, रिट याचिका क्र. ____/2026 मधील प्रतिवादी क्र. 2 यांचे परिच्छेदनिहाय अभिप्राय (इंग्रजी) व सहायक सरकारी वकील यांना पाठवावयाच्या पत्राचे प्रारूप पृ.      /प.वि. वर मान्यतेस्तव सादर. मान्य झाल्यास पत्र निर्गमित करण्यात येईल.

related.heading: Rules for the Conduct of the Legal Affairs of Government, 1984 — नियम 58(3), 58(4) व टीप (ii) (जसाच्या तसा; स्कॅन प्रतीवरून OCR)
text: “(3) … shall prepare or obtain parawise report on all the points raised in the Writ Petition and affidavit.”

“(4) … shall forward the complete case papers, as far as possible. within two weeks from the date of receipt by it …”; “(a) Recommendations whether the Writ Petition should or should not be opposed; (b) self-contained note making references to rules, orders and precedent[s]; (c) such additional information as is likely to help the Government Pleader”

“Note (ii) … the parawise report should not contain cryptic answers such as 'not admitted' or 'denied' but should contain elaborate factual position and should be invariably accompanied by copies of relevant notifications, rules and orders”
related.source: विधि व न्याय विभाग ठराव क्र. LOR-1284/(53B)-IX-(LOR Cell), दि. 15.11.1984, नियम 58(3), 58(4) व टीप (ii), पुस्तक पृ. 63-64 (पॅकेज PDF मध्ये नाही)

letter.subject: रिट याचिका क्र. ____/2026 (श्री. अ. ब. चाचणी विरुद्ध महाराष्ट्र शासन व इतर) मध्ये प्रतिवादी क्र. 2 यांचे परिच्छेदनिहाय अभिप्राय पाठविण्याबाबत.
letter.intro: उपरोक्त विषयाबाबत संदर्भाधीन पत्रास अनुसरून आपणांस कळविण्यात येते की, उपरोक्त रिट याचिकेत प्रतिवादी क्र. 2 (विधि व न्याय विभाग) यांचे परिच्छेदनिहाय अभिप्राय (इंग्रजी) संबंधित शासन निर्णयांच्या प्रतींसह सोबत पाठविण्यात येत आहेत. सदर अभिप्रायांच्या आधारे प्रतिज्ञापत्राचे प्रारूप तयार करून तथ्यांच्या पडताळणीसाठी या विभागास उपलब्ध करून देण्यात यावे, ही विनंती.
letter.enclosure: सोबत :- परिच्छेदनिहाय अभिप्राय (इंग्रजी) व संबंधित शासन निर्णयांच्या प्रती.

parawise.subject: Parawise remarks of Respondent No. 2 on the Writ Petition seeking grant of the ____ benefit to the petitioner with effect from __.__.____.
parawise.prepared_for: Assistant Government Pleader, High Court of Judicature at Bombay, Bench at Aurangabad
background: The petitioner is working as ____ in the District and Sessions Court, ____. He submitted a representation dated __.__.2025 seeking the ____ benefit with effect from __.__.____.
The representation was forwarded to the Government by the High Court under its letter dated __.__.2025.

The Law and Judiciary Department informed the High Court under letter No. ____ dated __.__.2025 that the petitioner does not fulfil the condition of ____ laid down in Government Resolution No. ____ dated __.__.____ (copy at Document No. 1).
Aggrieved thereby, the petitioner has filed the present Writ Petition. The Law and Judiciary Department is Respondent No. 2.

paras.averment: Description of the parties, the petitioner's appointment as ____ on __.__.____ and his service particulars.
paras.remarks: The particulars of the petitioner's appointment and service are a matter of the official record of the District and Sessions Court, ____. As per that record, the petitioner was appointed as ____ by order dated __.__.____ and joined on __.__.____. The remaining averments are not within the knowledge of this Respondent and the petitioner may be put to strict proof thereof.

paras.averment: The petitioner claims that he completed the qualifying service of ____ years on __.__.____ and became eligible for the ____ benefit.
paras.remarks: Government Resolution No. ____ dated __.__.____ (copy at Document No. 1), paragraph ____, prescribes ____ years of regular service and the condition of ____ for the grant of the ____ benefit. As per the service record received from the High Court with its letter dated __.__.2025, the petitioner's regular service is counted from __.__.____; the period from __.__.____ to __.__.____ was on an ad hoc basis and is not counted as regular service under paragraph ____ of the said Government Resolution. Hence the claim that he completed the qualifying service on __.__.____ is not correct.

paras.averment: The petitioner states that his representation dated __.__.2025 was not considered and that similarly placed employees were granted the benefit.
paras.remarks: The representation dated __.__.2025 was received through the High Court and was considered. The Department communicated its decision to the High Court under letter No. ____ dated __.__.2025 (copy at Document No. 2), stating the reason for rejection with reference to paragraph ____ of Government Resolution No. ____ dated __.__.____. The petitioner has not named the employees said to be similarly placed; the benefit is granted only to employees who fulfil the conditions of the said Government Resolution.

paras.averment: Grounds: the rejection is arbitrary and violates Articles 14 and 16 of the Constitution of India.
paras.remarks: The decision was taken by applying the uniform conditions laid down in Government Resolution No. ____ dated __.__.____, which apply equally to all employees of the cadre. No discrimination has been made against the petitioner. The Government Resolution itself has not been challenged in the petition.

paras.averment: The petitioner prays for a direction to grant the ____ benefit with effect from __.__.____ with arrears.
paras.remarks: In view of the remarks on paragraphs 4 to 7 above, the petitioner is not entitled to the benefit from the date claimed. The prayer is not maintainable and deserves to be rejected.
